prompt: leaderboard maps players to scores. On Redis 6.2 or newer, which call returns the ten highest-scoring players, best first?
explanation: ZRANGE with the REV option walks the sorted set from highest score to lowest, so ranks 0 through 9 are the ten best players. Without REV the range starts at the lowest score, and ZRANGEBYSCORE filters by score value rather than by rank. ZREVRANGE is the pre-6.2 spelling of the same reversed read.
